script.text: Thanks for coming. This session covers the changes to our benefits package that take effect in January. The two biggest ones. First, the company will now cover eighty percent of the dental plan instead of sixty. Second, we're adding two personal days that don't come out of your holiday allowance. Enrolment opens on the first of December and closes on the twentieth. If you do nothing, you'll simply stay on your current plan, but you'd miss the improved dental cover, so I'd encourage everyone to log in and review the options. Sena from human resources will stay behind afterwards for individual questions.

title: Quảng cáo khoá học ngoại ngữ buổi tối

script.text: Have you been meaning to learn Spanish for years? At Puente Language Centre our evening courses are built for people with full-time jobs. Classes run twice a week for ten weeks, and we cap every group at eight students so you actually get to speak. New this term, if you can't make a class, you can join that same session online and still keep your place. Our next intake begins the third of February, and there's a free trial lesson on the twenty-eighth of January so you can see whether the level suits you. Places go quickly, so book through our website.
